proposed_next_slice.identity: Bind each capture to its exact original method, URL, raw request text hash and monotonically assigned request sequence; reject ambiguous or superseded associations
assertions: Retrieve the actual cloned browser bytes, status and original headers; retain mandatory complete-body assertions and native profile/effective config comparisons
Preserve installed DOM, draft, storage, secret-scope, unknown/zero and no-effects assertions

not_allowed: No JSON POST retry or replay to obtain replacement bytes
No catch-fallback from a failed CDP read to an oracle labeled as the original browser body
No synthetic successful response or modified original Response
No timeout increase, disabled assertion or change to the running frozen screenshot acceptance
proposed_next_slice.independent_pure_oracle_limit: An unconditional independent pure /inspect oracle is behavior-safe but is a different body source. Current config_profiles.rs json_reply provides MIME and no-store without X-Content-SHA256, so matching status/length plus oracle SHA and installed DOM does not by itself establish byte identity of the original browser response. Any such alternative requires an explicit proof qualification.
